name: NASearch
description: NASearch — a lightweight, self-hosted file search UI for your Unraid array. Powered by plocate, it indexes your entire array in seconds and delivers instant search across millions of files — directly in your browser. FEATURES • Rich file previews — images, video (with seek), audio, PDF, rendered Markdown, interactive 3D STL models (WebGL, no plugins), and ZIP contents browser — all inline. • Folder browsing — click any result to explore its directory tree; download individual files or whole folders as ZIP archives. • Secure login — session-cookie authentication with CSRF protection and rate limiting. No credentials in URLs. • Themes & colour customisation — built-in dark, purple, slate, and light themes; set your own background, text, and accent colours; optional scanline overlay. • Auto-indexing — configurable scheduler (1 h to 7 days) or manual trigger via the UI; real-time progress indicator. No Elasticsearch. No Node. No build step. One container, one volume. IMPORTANT: You must set either AUTH_USER + AUTH_PASS (recommended) or NOAUTH=true before the app will start.

paths.name: Array Path
paths.description: Root of your Unraid array, mounted read-only. NASearch will index and serve files from here.

paths.name: Index & Config Storage
paths.description: Persistent storage for the plocate database and settings.json.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to access the NASearch web interface.

variables.name: Auth Username
variables.description: Login username. Set both AUTH_USER and AUTH_PASS to enable authentication (recommended).

variables.name: Auth Password
variables.description: Login password. Set both AUTH_USER and AUTH_PASS to enable authentication (recommended).

variables.name: Disable Auth
variables.description: Set to 'true' to explicitly disable authentication. Only use on a fully trusted, firewalled network. Either AUTH_USER+AUTH_PASS or NOAUTH=true must be set.

variables.name: Prune Paths
variables.description: Space-separated list of paths to skip during indexing.

variables.name: Max Results
variables.description: Maximum number of search results returned per query.

labels.name: Homepage: Name
labels.description: Display name shown on your Homepage dashboard. Leave blank if you are not using Homepage (https://gethomepage.dev).

labels.name: Homepage: Group
labels.description: Dashboard group/category to place NASearch in (e.g. Tools, Media, System). Leave blank if not using Homepage.

labels.name: Homepage: URL
labels.description: Full URL Homepage should link to (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000 or your reverse-proxy address). Leave blank if not using Homepage.
